name: 28759 · Mills River, NC
findings: ZIP 28759 (Mills River) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28759 (Mills River) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28759 (Mills River) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
